organization.name_ja: Suishow株式会社（モバイルファクトリー子会社）

affected.note: Estimated counts from the third-party investigation (2023-12-07): current location of about 3.04 million users (2022-09-29 to 2023-05-08), chat content and images of about 1.67 million, and birthdates of about 2.83 million were accessible. NHK had reported at least 2 million. The investigation found no evidence that data was actually taken.

summary.en: After NHK reported that location data and chats of at least 2 million NauNau users could be viewed from outside, operator Suishow commissioned a third-party investigation. It found that a cloud security misconfiguration had made the current location of an estimated 3.04 million users, as well as chats and birthdates, accessible, though no outflow was confirmed.
summary.ja: 位置情報共有アプリ「NauNau」で少なくとも200万人の位置情報やチャットが外部から閲覧可能だったとNHKが報じたことを受け、運営するSuishowは第三者機関に調査を依頼した。クラウドのセキュリティ設定の不備により推定304万ユーザーの現在地のほか、チャットや生年月日にアクセスできる状態だったが、流出の事実は確認されなかった。
